description: Header file defining the class 'dm_network_list_t' which manages a list of networks, including functions for initialization, encoding/decoding JSON data, database synchronization, and network management operations. It also declares virtual methods for network iteration and retrieval which are meant to be implemented by derived classes.

classes.name: dm_network_list_t
classes.description: A class handling a list of network objects with functionalities for initialization, JSON encoding/decoding, database synchronization, and network management. It inherits from 'dm_network_t' and 'db_easy_mesh_t' and contains several virtual methods for network traversal and manipulation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the network list, preparing internal data structures for use.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a JSON array into a parent structure.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a JSON object array.

methods.name: get_dm_orch_type
methods.description: Determines the orchestration type for a given network using a database client.

methods.name: update_list
methods.description: Updates the network list based on the specified operation type.

methods.name: delete_list
methods.description: Clears all entries from the network list.

methods.name: get_ctrl_al_interface
methods.description: Returns the control interface associated with a network identifier.

methods.name: init_table
methods.description: Initializes the network table.

methods.name: init_columns
methods.description: Initializes columns for the network list display.

methods.name: sync_db
methods.description: Synchronizes the network list with the database.

methods.name: update_db
methods.description: Updates the database with operation and data.

methods.name: search_db
methods.description: Searches the database for a key.

methods.name: operator ==
methods.description: Checks for equality with another 'db_easy_mesh_t' object.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Configures network settings with database client and network info.

methods.name: set_config (overloaded)
methods.description: Sets configuration using a JSON object.

methods.name: get_config
methods.description: Retrieves configuration details into JSON, possibly providing a summary.

methods.name: get_first_network
methods.description: Returns the first network in the list. Pure virtual.

methods.name: get_next_network
methods.description: Returns the subsequent network in the list. Pure virtual.

methods.name: get_network
methods.description: Retrieves network object by key. Pure virtual.

methods.name: remove_network
methods.description: Removes network identified by key. Pure virtual.

methods.name: put_network
methods.description: Stores network information with a key. Pure virtual.
